hero.title: Parts Management System
hero.description: This system is a comprehensive solution for ordering, monitoring and controlling all activities of non-conforming product reporting, claims, replacement part requests or purchase requests in your organization. Using this system, you can register desired information and manage your orders optimally, and provide information in the shortest possible time.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: The ordering system helps you manage parts better with its features

items.title: Corrective Action
items.description: Register and track required corrective actions from suppliers

items.title: Parts Claim
items.description: Report defective parts and request parts claims

items.title: Mobile Access
items.description: Access the system via mobile phone and tablet anytime, anywhere
